why: goh release-quiet (GOH.RELHIDE): a release step that sends its output to /dev/null -- this repository's findings on the day the check landed, keyed by its root commit. At or under its count warns; over it, unseeded, or an entry a full run finds clean is red. Fix the site and delete or lower its entry in the same commit: done is an empty list. A seed entry lives in its own repository's tree or goh's private store, never another repository's (GOH.SEEDPRIVATE).
